goal.decided: rn makes each deliverable the user means, every deliverable meeting each intent of its best practice, and asks the user only what's theirs.

deliverables.name: lovaizu/checks checks all the text that ccpm keeps
Lane's design checks each practice step and each change
Each best practice holds the field's established way, named so its maker grasps the intent
The shared plugin best practice says what rn and Lane share
Each part a developer builds by the design gives, with the others, the product vision
A maker of code designs it, tests it first, and writes it as the field's established practice says
An AI given a prompt does the task as its writer means, in cases the writer didn't foresee
The user reaches their goal through the plan's deliverables, which leave nothing out and start nothing too early
This plan holds every deliverable the goal needs, each after what it stands on
A developer builds from the product vision a product with which its users achieve their aim
A newcomer starts using the product from its README alone, only when it serves their work
A reader takes in a reworked document as its writer meant, reading once from the top
Lane's code has a design, tests written first, and code as the code best practice says

decisions.decided: Lane's code needs Python 3.9 and its standard library alone, and its tests the dev group of pyproject.toml
each test writes only in a temporary folder of its own, as FolderTest of testing.py sets it, and a stand-in for claude or python3 lies in that folder

decisions.about: The modules beside the architecture's components
decisions.decided: domain/ holds plugin.py for the plugin's manifest and entries, laid.py for the form of a proposal and of hooks/lanes.json, command.py for how a command reads and matches, and schema.py for JSON Schema, each shared by several components
scripts/ holds sentences.py for where a sentence goes in a step, entries.py for the hook entries, and lane_code.py for a link or a copy of Lane's code
hook.py alone is the entry of every event, as the hook input names its event. The architecture's entry for each event would add files that decide nothing
guard.py holds a role's events, conversation.py the main conversation's run, and exchange.py the event and the answer that pass between hook.py and them, so that no two modules import each other

decisions.about: The sentences a role's steps carry
decisions.decided: laid.py gives each sentence that the lanes and routes lay, for lay.py to write and for the guard to find in the steps

a name without a leading underscore is a module's interface. Its docstring says what it gives, what it expects, and each error it raises, and a comment before each field of a NamedTuple says what the field holds
lay.py refuses a proposal outside .lane/<folder>/, as lanes.md keeps it there and lay.py write removes that folder
a copy of Lane's code holds the version it came from in hooks/lane/VERSION, which lay.py up reads
schema.py reads in a form the keywords that structured outputs accept, pattern among them, and refuses format, as Lane checks no format
the guard gives a role its part as it starts only where the part is a file apart from the entry, as Claude Code gives the entry's body already
a role gives a result where the routes name it, where it names its results, or where it has a lane checked at the end or of the trace kind, so that the guard checks its traces as it ends
called.py adds each entry as one line at the end of record.jsonl in one write, so hooks that run at once each add a whole line, and a run's state comes from the entries alone
the guard reads stop_hook_active, which Claude Code gives Stop and SubagentStop, to tell a role or a turn kept going once, and keeps no mark of its own
a prompt that begins with <task-notification> brings a role's end and is none of the person's words, as a try of Claude Code 2.1.319 showed

decisions.about: A file read to its end
decisions.decided: the guard keeps a Read's file's lines as they stood when the Read came back, so a later change of the file leaves the trace as the Read made it
a lane's sentence lists its takes with `or`, so a trace or a lane checked at the end holds where any one of its takes does, while every_item asks each item of each input
an output holds to a Markdown template where it has each heading of the template in the template's order, more headings among them, and each key of the template's frontmatter

decisions.about: Fields that the reference leaves out
decisions.decided: SendMessage gives `to` and `message`, and Bash gives back `stdout`, as the old Lane's tries of Claude Code recorded them
hook.py holds the hook input, proposal.py the proposal, and laid.py hooks/lanes.json to their form where each comes in, and each refusal says what's wrong and who must fix it
hook.py exits 2 with why, which blocks each event that can block

decisions.about: Where a lane type's tests lie
decisions.decided: beside the tests of domain/, as a test folder named lanes would stand for the package lanes in the type check
schema.py keeps checked, held, Out, Unread and the wording of a missing key, which rn's scripts and dev/scripts rest on

Lane's old code and its tests went whole at the first slice, as each old module rested on the others. The old architecture tests, trials and test of the double of Claude Code went with them, for the next deliverable to make anew
check.sh leaves out rn's architecture tests, and lefthook.yml rn's hooks, until rn's code deliverable lays rn anew on the rebuilt Lane

deliverables.name: Lane's code does what its design says

decisions.decided: Lane's code and tests made before go whole, and the improved code best practice makes Lane anew, as no one can tell where code made without it falls short

on Opus by dev/lane/tests/product-vision/trial.py, its plugin given a part with no numbered list, a steps adapter, a start-text command and a route that waits for the person, and its judge counting steps out of order, starts unlike the command's text and resumes not in the person's words. Its judge is first right on kept records whose answer someone knows

deliverables.name: Lane's README reads as its writer meant, to a newcomer reading it once
rn's product vision says what rn is for
rn's design says how a turn carries out a best practice
rn's code has a design, tests written first, and code as the code best practice says
Each of rn's roles does its part as its prompt means, on every run
rn works as designed, and no Pin or Turn remains

decisions.decided: meta's form gives each practice step a trace a machine can check, and each kind's steps get one, so rn's steps adapter hands Lane what to hold

not used: a case is one prompt in an empty workspace that never stops for an answer, while rn's walkthrough answers points and resumes. The product vision trials run on Lane's trial driver in lovaizu/playground
plugins/pin and plugins/turn go once rn holds their parts. The branch turn-held keeps the eight Turn commits no branch held, rn takes each where its design keeps what it fixes, then the branch goes
Lane's guard stops reading prompts/ and core/roles/ in the change that removes Pin and Turn, as their parts lie there until then
a run lane whose value is null lets no command through, and a run_step command the adapter gives counts as allowed, so the generator gets run_only

decisions.about: A file a role must not read
decisions.decided: Lane gains a lane that stops a read of the files it names, and the planner and generator get it for the design tree, as no role reads the tree
the skill names tree.py in allowed-tools, and the prose check reads no front matter, as a prompt per call costs the user time

decisions.about: Picking up a run on another branch
decisions.decided: /rn:up alone finds the runs on rn's work branches and picks up the one the user means, asking only where more than one waits
rn's code and tests made before go whole, and the improved code best practice makes rn anew, as no one can tell where code made without it falls short

deliverables.name: A newcomer learns from the README what rn does

decisions.decided: once the rebuilt rn exists, the maker follows its install steps from nothing as a newcomer would, and mends the README where they fall short
the walkthrough takes its output from a recorded run of the rebuilt rn, the product vision test's own
